title: The Fungal Wanderer
description: A figure steps from behind a massive mushroom stalk -- humanoid, but wrong. Its skin is textured like bark, its eyes glow faint green, and clusters of tiny mushrooms sprout from its shoulders and scalp. It raises a hand in greeting. The myconid speaks in a voice like rustling leaves, offering to trade what it has gathered in its long wandering of the depths.

choices.label: Trade with the wanderer
choices.description: Offer gold for the myconid's gathered materials.

outcomes.text: The myconid opens a woven sack and spreads its wares. Quality materials -- it knows its craft. A fair trade for both sides.
The wanderer's eyes brighten at your coin. It digs deep in its pack and produces something special -- a glowing spore, pulsing with concentrated bioluminescence.
The myconid takes your gold but its wares are... middling. Old fiber, half-dried clusters. You've been had by a mushroom.

choices.label: Ask for knowledge
choices.description: The myconid has walked these tunnels for decades. Its knowledge might be more valuable than goods.

outcomes.text: The wanderer presses a palm to the tunnel wall. The mycelium network lights up, revealing safe paths ahead. Its parting gift: a healing fungal salve.
The myconid shares the locations of several material deposits it passed. You follow its directions to a rich vein of spore clusters.
The wanderer speaks in cryptic fungal metaphors for twenty minutes. You learn nothing useful, but it seemed to enjoy the conversation.

choices.label: Attack the creature
choices.description: A walking mushroom is still a monster. Strike first.

outcomes.text: The myconid shrieks and releases a cloud of stunning spores before you can land a blow. When your vision clears, it's gone -- but it dropped its pack in its flight.
The wanderer raises its hand and the tunnel floor erupts. Mycelium tendrils lash out as fungal creatures burst from the walls. It was never alone.
Your blade cuts deep and the myconid collapses, spilling materials from its pack. Its dying breath releases a toxic spore cloud that coats everyone.
